class.name: IfcMaterialConstituent
class.brief_description: IfcMaterialConstituent is a single and identifiable part of an element which is constructed of a number of part (one or more) each having an individual material. The association of the material constituent to the part is provided by a keyword as value of the Name attribute. NOTE See the "Material Use Definition" at the individual element to which an IfcMaterialConstituentSet may apply for a requir
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The name by which the material constituent is known. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Definition of the material constituent in descriptive terms. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Reference to the material from which the constituent is constructed. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Optional provision of a fraction of the total amount (volume or weight) that applies to the IfcMaterialConstituentSet that is contributed by this IfcMaterialConstituent . A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

Category of the material constituent, e.g. the role it has in the constituent set it belongs to. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it is empty.
